page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2a-c1m2.12xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the ecs.u2a family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs powered by AMD EPYC processors operating at a clock speed of 2.25 GHz. The instance is configured with 96.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring network-attached storage for persistent data. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 13 Gbps. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this server as a compute-heavy resource, optimizing expenditures for workloads that demand high CPU allocation relative to memory capacity without the added cost of bundled local SSDs.

The dedicated AMD EPYC processor cores and 13 Gbps network bandwidth make this instance suitable for compute-intensive workloads. Appropriate use cases include batch processing, web serving, distributed analytics, and CI/CD pipelines that require high parallel processing capabilities but do not demand massive memory footprints or local storage.
